XXVII, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 27:5">5</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 27:33">33</cite>; a. fr.—Part. <cite ref="R00334"><he>צָיֵיד</he></cite>, <cite ref="R00002"><he>צָאֵיד</he></cite>, <cite ref="R00002"><he>צָאֵד</he></cite>; f. <he>צָיְידָא</he>, <he>צָיְדָא</he> &c.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 6:26">Targ. Prov. VI, 26</cite> (Ms. <cite ref="R00106"><he>צדיא</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="R00103"><he>צְדֵי</he> I</cite>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 23:28">Ib. XXIII, 28</cite> <he>צָאִידָא בניא וכ׳</he> ed. Lag. (ed. <he>צאר אבנא</he>, corr. acc.) she catches thoughtless youths.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 2:19">Ib. II, 19</cite> <he>צָיְדִין</he> (some ed. <he>ציירין</he>, corr. acc.; h. text <he>ישיגו</he>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:23">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵃ</cite> <he>דצָיֵיד</he>, v. <cite ref="K00216"><he>כַּוְורָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 85b:6">B. Mets. 85ᵇ</cite> <he>וצָיִידְנָא טבי</he>; <cite ref="Ketubot 103b:19">Keth. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>וצָיִדְנָא</he> (Rashi <he>וצדיינא</he>), v. <cite ref="I00050"><he>טַבְיָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 67:2">Gen. R. s. 67</cite> <he>ציידא היך צָדוּךְ</he> how they caught thee, O hunter! <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 10:10:4">Y. B. Bath. X, end, 17ᵈ</cite> <he>בר נש דהוה צייד לחבריה וכ׳</he> if a man catches his neighbor in the street (for a debt), and one comes and says, let him go &c. Ib. VIII, 16ᵇ top <he>לא צייד כלום</he> he catches (obtains) nothing.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 11a:14">M. Kat. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>אזיל … צוּד</he> all went out and fished; a. fr.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 6:2">Targ. Prov. VI, 2</cite>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30">Lev. R. s. 30</cite> <he>אתציד התוא וכ׳</he> (ed. Wil. <cite ref="R00162"><he>אצתייד</he></cite>, oth. ed. <cite ref="R00162"><he>אתצייד</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="L00493"><he>לִיסְטָאָה</he></cite>. Y. Yeb. XVI, beg. 15ᶜ; Y. Sot. IX, 23ᶜ bot. <he>ואִתְצִידוּן וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="B00552"><he>בִּידָּא</he></cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 79:6">Gen. R. s. 79</cite> <he>הוות מִתַּצְּדָה וכ׳</he> it (the bird) was caught and captured, v. <cite ref="O01368"><he>סְפִיקוּלָא</he> I</cite>; a. e.
